summary: The paper’s Table 1 reports obesity-versus-control log2 fold changes for 54 genes also responsive to resveratrol. Of 23 genes with an unambiguous registered effect, 22 agree in direction and M6pr-ps reverses. Coverage of the selected list is 42.59%, below the author-concordance-v2 requirement, and the pair count is below 30.

manualReview.summary: Selected obesity effects compared in the six registered hypothalamus libraries
manualReview.note: GEO links this study to PMID 41898832. Raw-read totals from supplementary Table S1 match ENA for C1–C3 and OB1–OB3. The deposited matrix contains integer counts. The manuscript itself gives 54 selected Table 1 obesity-versus-control coefficients. Exact, one-to-one feature joins give 23 paired effects, with 22 matching directions, Pearson 0.912609, Spearman 0.869286 and a median absolute log2FC difference of 0.194968. M6pr-ps is +2.65 in the paper and −0.100759 in the registered output. The paper reports 393 obesity DEGs by its joint adjusted-P and effect-size rule. The registered output has zero genes with FDR < 0.05. Individual author P and FDR values are unavailable. The per-gene audit and the conflicting Ppargc1b entries are retained in data/author-validation/continued-sources/GSE329539/codex-2026-11-21.
reviewFlags: Only 23 of the 54 RSV-responsive genes have a one-to-one registered coefficient. Author-concordance-v2 requires at least 30 pairs and 90% selected-reference coverage.
Ppargc1b is −1.93 in Table 1 and −1.46 in Table 2 for Ob vs. C. M6pr-ps has opposite author and registered directions.
The complete author DESeq2 table and model inputs are unavailable. The paper and GEO describe different alignment workflows.
This legacy source has no committed source-file checksum manifest.

verificationReview.reason: Compared all published Table 1 Ob vs. C coefficients against the registered edgeR-QL table. One-to-one stable-ID mapping paired 23 of 54 selected genes, with 22 matching directions. M6pr-ps reverses, the two manuscript tables disagree about the magnitude of Ppargc1b, and the difference between the reported and registered significant-gene counts remains unexplained. No per-gene P/FDR values were published in these tables.
verificationReview.nextStep: Obtain the full Ob vs. C DESeq2 results, gene IDs and annotation, input count matrix, design and filtering settings. Confirm which Ppargc1b coefficient is intended and use those files to reconcile M6pr-ps and the reported obesity discoveries.

comparabilityReview.basis: Registered whole-hypothalamus edgeR-QL output compared directly to the signed Table 1 DESeq2 Ob vs. C column. Its 54 RSV-responsive genes define the reference denominator.
comparabilityReview.reference: De la Cruz-Concepción et al., Genes 2026, DOI 10.3390/genes17030297, Tables 1 and 2. Table 1 is primary because it enumerates the entire selected list and its Ensembl IDs. Table S1 and ENA independently establish the sample mapping.

cohort.note: The publication reports three biological RNA-seq replicates per arm. S1 raw-read totals for each numbered sample match twice the paired ENA spot count for its linked GEO library. C1–C3 and OB1–OB3 are vehicle-treated male C57BL/6 whole hypothalami. Treated arms are excluded from the registered fit.

contrast.note: Untreated HFD-obese minus standard-diet control from the same terminal tissue collection. Table 1 labels the coefficient Ob vs. C. Orientation sign is +1. Response to RSV determines list membership only.

features.note: Only exact author Ensembl IDs with a unique deposited source feature per registered symbol enter the paired analysis. This recovers Snail1/Snai1, Olfr543/Or55b3 and Gm47283/Erdr1y. The Ccl27a symbol belongs to different stable IDs in the paper and deposit. Palm2 contributes to a three-feature Pakap aggregate. Both remain unpaired.

effects.note: Both estimates are signed log2 case/control changes in gene expression. The paper attributes its rounded coefficients to DESeq2 and the registered fit uses edgeR-QL. In the 23 pairs, Pearson is 0.912609, Spearman is 0.869286 and 22 directions agree. Median absolute difference is 0.194968 and the paired RMS magnitude ratio (registered/author) is 0.769399. M6pr-ps changes sign. Using the alternative Ppargc1b value from Table 2 leaves the direction count and policy decision unchanged.

inference.note: The paper used DESeq2 with BH adjustment and reports 393 Ob vs. C DEGs at adjusted P < 0.05 and |log2FC| ≥ 1. Registered edgeR-QL has 0 of 20,008 published rows at FDR < 0.05, including 0 of 23 paired genes. There are 17 nominal local P < 0.05 among the pairs. Author per-gene raw P and adjusted P are unavailable, so numerical P/FDR comparisons and full-universe call overlap remain unassessed. The paper reports HISAT2 alignment while GEO reports Rsubread.

coverage.note: 23 of 54 selected author genes pair (42.59%), representing 23 of 20,008 registered rows (0.115%). Another 27 map uniquely outside the registered DE table, three published stable IDs are absent from the deposit and one maps to a multi-feature aggregate. The selected list is the obesity/RSV intersection. Table 2 repeats nine Table 1 genes.

comparabilityReview.criteria: Use the published Ob vs. C column at orientation +1 and all unique one-to-one pairs, without magnitude filtering. Author-concordance-v2 requires compatible cohort, contrast, features and effect definitions, at least 30 pairs and 90% coverage of this selected reference. It also requires either Pearson and Spearman each ≥ 0.90, or ≥ 90% matching directions among ≥ 30 nonzero pairs covering ≥ 90% of the pairs. Magnitude and inference are contextual.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: The selected-gene comparison is complete. With 23 pairs and 42.59% selected-reference coverage, neither v2 route passes. Spearman falls below 0.90. Directional agreement is 95.65% across all 23 pairs, fewer than the required 30. The published significant-gene counts and the Ppargc1b discrepancy remain unreconciled.

additionalComparisonSpec.orientation: Ob vs. C as printed in Table 1, untreated obese minus control in whole hypothalamus.
additionalComparisonSpec.authorMethod: DESeq2 1.20.0, rounded Ob vs. C log2FC in manuscript Table 1
additionalComparisonSpec.note: All 54 author-selected rows retained. A key is the registered symbol only for an exact one-to-one source-feature match with a published DE row. Other rows retain the original Ensembl ID and remain outside the join. Compare 23 pairs with no author P/FDR. The two tables give different magnitudes for Ppargc1b. The alternative is recorded separately. M6pr-ps reverses. Coverage and pair count preclude v2 acceptance.

originalReferences.sourceUrl: Reproducible Table 1 extraction, Table 2 cross-check and stable-ID joins

additionalComparisonSpec.resultScope: All 54 selected RSV-responsive genes in the Table 1 Ob vs. C column. Comparison is limited to matched effects.

computed.value: 54 author genes, 23 one-to-one pairs (42.592593%), 27 uniquely mapped outside the published DE table, 3 missing stable IDs, 1 multi-feature aggregate. Registered coverage 23/20,008 (0.114954%).

computed.claim: Ob vs. C effect agreement for the full set of usable Table 1 pairs
computed.value: Pearson 0.9126091605, Spearman 0.8692859173, same direction 22/23 (95.652174%), nonzero pairs 23/23, median absolute difference 0.1949678430, RMSE 0.9668370295, RMS magnitude ratio 0.7693989774.

All 9 unique Table 2 genes are in Table 1. Ppargc1b has Ob vs. C −1.93 in Table 1, −1.46 in Table 2, and −1.26671833164999 locally. Using the Table 2 alternate gives Pearson 0.9129435322, Spearman 0.8692859173 and 22/23 same directions.
Paper reports 393 obesity DEGs. Registered FDR < 0.05 in 0/20,008 published rows and 0/23 paired rows. Raw local P < 0.05 in 17/23 pairs. Numeric author P/FDR available for 0 pairs.

computed.claim: GEO file contents and sample identity
computed.value: 78,334 feature rows, 12 count columns, no GSM supplements, zero gene rows in the series matrix. All 9 Table S1 raw-read totals agree with paired ENA run counts, including all 3 control and 3 untreated-obesity libraries.
No acceptance. Both common numerical requirements fail (23 < 30 pairs and 42.59% < 90% selected-reference coverage). Spearman < 0.90. The direction route has fewer than 30 nonzero pairs.

openIssues: The authors’ full obesity-versus-control DESeq2 results, per-gene P/FDR, original gene annotation and exact model inputs are needed to reconcile the reported 393 DEGs with zero registered FDR discoveries.
The paper gives two obesity log2 fold changes for Ppargc1b. The source of that discrepancy and the sign reversal for M6pr-ps remain unresolved.
